Business Name: Dunham & Jones, Attorneys at Law, P.C.
Description: Dunham & Jones, Attorneys at Law, provides criminal defense, jail release, and bail bond assistance in Abilene and throughout Taylor County, Texas. Since 1989, our attorneys have represented clients facing DWI, assault and family violence, drug possession, and other criminal charges, with the #1 goal of obtaining a dismissal or reduction. We also assist with jail magistration, bond reduction hearings, PR bonds, cash bonds, surety bonds, and bail bond coordination. Our Criminal Defense and Jail Release Team answers calls 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Under Texas law, a licensed Texas attorney representing a criminal defendant is authorized, in appropriate cases, to execute a bail bond or act as a surety for that client.
